changes.title: See Blacksmith reward upgrades
changes.text: Blacksmith reward choices now show each actual upgrade level before selection, without identifying its curse or deferred enchantment.

changes.title: Explicit zero-level rewards
changes.text: Blacksmith reward slots use the native upgrade font and colors and show +0 explicitly; other inventory slots keep their existing display.

changes.title: Reward identity and native selection checks
changes.text: Added tests for hidden properties, unchanged rewards and RNG, save persistence, visible levels and selecting the exact offered item on Android.

changes.title: Verified build and private delivery records
changes.text: Recorded the preceding build's real Android results and prepared private artifact reuse with signing and checksum checks.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I made the Blacksmith's offered upgrade levels visible using the same disclosure as the Sad Ghost. The rewards themselves are unchanged.
